|translation='''Title:''' Nalan Cheel.

'''Card text:'''
Immediately after using Bith Shuffle, you may look at the top X cards of the shuffled deck. X = the number of musicians at the same location card. You may shuffle again instead of looking.

'''Lore:'''
A male Bith musician. He enjoys playing in Figrin D'an's band, but sometimes misses the bubbling pink swamps of Clak'dor VII where he grew up.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' Japanese X is musicians at the same location; English counts other musicians at the same site.
